remarks: Stunning like new home w/spacious & bright rooms, conveniently located close to town, train, schools & park. High ceilings & quality details meet smart home technology w/Sonos audio, smart doorbell & thermostats & included mounted TVs. Gourmet eat-in kitchen w/breakfast area opens to adjacent family room w/fireplace. First floor features dining room, wine bar,living room w/fireplace & French doors to deck, library w/wet bar & first floor bedroom suite. Second floor has lovely primary suite w/fireplace, sitting room, walk-in closet & luxurious bathroom. More en-suite bedrooms, laundry room & giant play/game room complete this level. Amazing private backyard w/large deck, resort like heated in-ground pool w/waterfall & stone patio. Backyard access to Montgomery Pinetum for exploring & relaxing.
